patch_description: The current program uses max-normalized relay pressure and spreads every two-hop reward across all possible intermediates. This version uses mean-normalized pressure with a higher 0.85 floor, then allocates each OD pair’s indirect reward to at most four promising relays. It adds a modest penalty for redundant incoming or outgoing neighbor profiles, while keeping the total number of quadratic terms well below the allowed limit. The direct-link reward remains demand-focused, with a smaller endpoint contribution.
